resources.name: Missouri 211
resources.description: Social services information and referral for all Missouri counties

resources.name: Missouri Child Abuse/Neglect Hotline
resources.description: Report suspected child abuse or neglect. Missouri is a universal mandatory reporting state.

resources.name: Missouri Adult Abuse/Neglect Hotline
resources.hours: Daily 7am-8pm (online reports 24/7 at moapss.health.mo.gov; call 911 in an emergency)
resources.description: Report suspected abuse, neglect, or exploitation of vulnerable adults.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Call or text 988 for suicide, mental health, or substance use crisis support.

resources.name: Crisis Text Line
resources.description: Text-based crisis support for any type of crisis.

resources.name: National Domestic Violence Hotline
resources.description: Confidential support, safety planning, and referrals for DV survivors. Multilingual.

resources.name: SAMHSA National Helpline
resources.description: Treatment referrals, information, and support for substance use and mental health.

resources.name: RAINN National Sexual Assault Hotline
resources.description: Crisis support for sexual assault survivors. Also online at online.rainn.org.

resources.name: National Human Trafficking Hotline
resources.description: Report trafficking, get help, or request services for survivors.

resources.name: St. Louis Area Foodbank
resources.description: Regional food bank serving 26 counties in eastern Missouri. Find pantries at stlfoodbank.org.

resources.name: Harvesters — The Community Food Network
resources.description: Regional food bank serving 26 counties in western Missouri and NE Kansas.

resources.name: Ozarks Food Harvest
resources.description: Regional food bank serving 28 counties in SW Missouri.

resources.name: Behavioral Health Response
resources.description: CCBHC providing crisis services, counseling, psychiatry, substance use treatment, and crisis stabilization.

resources.name: Compass Health Network
resources.description: CCBHC providing MH, SUD, primary care, dental, and crisis services across central and NE Missouri.

resources.name: Burrell Behavioral Health
resources.description: CCBHC providing MH, SUD, crisis, and community support services in SW Missouri.

resources.name: Legal Services of Eastern Missouri
resources.description: Free civil legal services for low-income residents: housing, family law, benefits, consumer, immigration.

resources.name: Legal Aid of Western Missouri
resources.description: Free civil legal services for low-income residents in western Missouri.
resources.note: Removed phone_alt 1-866-534-2568: not found on lawmo.org or its brochure. Branch toll-free lines are on lawmo.org.

resources.name: Missouri Family Support Division (FSD)
resources.description: SNAP, TANF, Medicaid, child care subsidy, energy assistance applications and case management.

resources.name: Missouri First Steps (Early Intervention)
resources.description: Developmental services for infants and toddlers (birth to 3) with developmental delays or disabilities.

resources.name: Parents as Teachers (PAT)
resources.description: Free home visiting for families with children prenatal to age 5. Contact local school district to enroll.

resources.name: St. Louis Housing Authority
resources.description: Public housing and Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) program for St. Louis City.

resources.name: OATS Transit
resources.description: Rural transit serving 87 Missouri counties. Door-to-door service. Priority for seniors 60+ and people with disabilities.
resources.note: Corporate line per oatstransit.org; riders schedule trips through their regional office (listed on the site).

resources.name: Missouri Vocational Rehabilitation
resources.description: Employment services for people with disabilities: counseling, training, job placement, assistive technology.

resources.name: Missouri Protection & Advocacy Services
resources.description: Legal advocacy for disability rights: ADA, special education, abuse/neglect, guardianship alternatives.

resources.name: MPACT (Missouri Parents Act)
resources.description: Parent Training & Information Center. Free special education advocacy for families of children with disabilities.

resources.description: WIOA employment services: job matching, resume help, interview prep, training referrals.

resources.name: Missouri SHIP (formerly CLAIM)
resources.description: Free Medicare counseling: plan comparison, enrollment help, billing issues, appeals.

resources.name: Missouri Rx Plan (MoRx)

resources.name: Eldercare Locator

resources.name: Childhelp National Child Abuse Hotline
resources.description: Crisis intervention, information, and referrals for child abuse situations.

resources.name: Trevor Project
resources.description: Crisis intervention and suicide prevention for LGBTQ+ young people.

resources.name: Family Care Health Centers
resources.address: 3824 S Grand Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63118

resources.name: Swope Health

resources.description: FQHC providing primary care, behavioral health, dental, pharmacy, and WIC services in the KC metro.

resources.name: Samuel U. Rodgers Health Center
resources.description: FQHC providing primary care, dental, behavioral health, and pharmacy. Serves uninsured and underinsured patients.

resources.name: Gateway Homeless Services (Peter & Paul)
resources.description: Emergency shelter for single adults and families experiencing homelessness in St. Louis City.
resources.note: NEEDS REVIEW: this entry mixes two organizations. 314-231-1515 is reported as Gateway180 (women, children, families; 1000 N 19th St). Peter & Paul Community Services (ppcsinc.org) runs a referral-only shelter for single men via 211 or St. Patrick Center. The listed address matched neither and was removed.

resources.name: City Union Mission
resources.description: Emergency shelter, meals, and recovery programs for men, women, and families in Kansas City.
resources.note: Shelter Hotline for people experiencing homelessness: 816-474-4599 (cityunionmission.org).

resources.name: Missouri Coalition Against Domestic and Sexual Violence (MCADSV)
resources.description: Statewide coalition connecting survivors to local DV shelters and services. Find your local program via website.

resources.name: Safe Connections
resources.description: 24-hour crisis helpline (call or text), crisis intervention, individual therapy, prevention education, and support services for survivors of domestic and sexual violence. Not a shelter.

resources.name: VA St. Louis Health Care System
resources.address: 1 Jefferson Barracks Dr, St. Louis, MO 63125
resources.description: VA medical center providing primary care, mental health, substance use treatment, and specialty care for veterans.

resources.name: Kansas City VA Medical Center
resources.address: 4801 E Linwood Blvd, Kansas City, MO 64128
resources.description: VA medical center serving veterans in western Missouri and eastern Kansas.

resources.name: Veterans Crisis Line
resources.description: Crisis support for veterans, service members, and their families. Call 988 then press 1.

resources.name: Preferred Family Healthcare
resources.description: Statewide SUD and mental health treatment provider with 80+ locations. Offers detox, residential, outpatient, and MAT.
resources.note: NEEDS CALL: 1-800-731-3070 is not listed on pfh.org (HQ 660-665-1962). Site now reads 'Preferred Family Health'.

resources.name: NCADA (National Council on Alcoholism & Drug Abuse — St. Louis)
resources.description: Substance use assessment, education, outpatient treatment, and recovery support in the St. Louis area.
resources.note: NEEDS REVIEW: NCADA-St. Louis appears to operate as PreventEd (prevented.org) and focuses on prevention and early intervention, not treatment. Name, phone, website and type unconfirmed.

resources.name: Missouri Reentry Process
resources.description: Missouri DOC reentry resources including transition planning, employment, housing, and ID recovery for returning citizens.

resources.name: Keyway Center for Diversion and Reentry (formerly Center for Women in Transition)
resources.description: Reentry services for women: housing, employment, case management, and family reunification.
resources.note: NEEDS CALL: renamed in 2022 (National Institute of Corrections). Phone 314-588-8300 and address unconfirmed; check keywaycenter.org.

resources.name: Central Missouri Community Action (CMCA)
resources.description: Community Action Agency administering LIHEAP, weatherization, emergency rent/utility assistance, and food programs.

resources.name: Delta Area Economic Opportunity Corporation
resources.description: Community Action Agency serving the Bootheel. Head Start, LIHEAP, emergency assistance, and food distribution.
resources.note: Sikeston Outreach Center per dss.mo.gov; LIHEAP: 573-931-8400. The previous 573-471-4426 is not listed on any official source.

resources.name: Child Care Aware of Missouri
resources.description: Statewide child care resource and referral. Helps families find quality child care and navigate subsidy applications.

resources.name: International Institute of St. Louis
resources.description: Refugee resettlement, immigration legal services, ESL classes, employment services, and citizenship assistance.
resources.note: NEEDS CALL: 314-773-9090 could not be confirmed on iistl.org (contact page blocked automated checks).

resources.name: reStart Inc.
resources.description: Emergency shelter and interim housing in downtown Kansas City for single adults, families with children, youth (ages 18-24 transitional living) and veterans, plus outreach, case management and permanent housing support.

resources.name: St. Louis County Housing Authority
resources.description: Public housing and Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) program for St. Louis County residents.

resources.name: Housing Authority of Kansas City
resources.description: Public housing and Housing Choice Voucher program for Kansas City residents.
resources.note: NEEDS CALL: HUD lists 816-968-4100 and 816-968-4110 for this agency without saying which is the fax. Confirm on hakc.org.

resources.name: Missouri Job Centers (statewide)
resources.description: WIOA employment services: job matching, resume help, interview prep, training referrals. 30+ locations statewide.
